issues.quote: revenue rising 29.4% to $198.3 billion from $168.1 billion
issues.problem: The growth rate is wrong. $198.3B / $168.1B gives about 18.0% growth, not 29.4%. It also contradicts the later 'high-teens growth' description, and with 29.4% the claim that profit growth outpaced revenue would be false.

data.summary: Revenue growth is misstated as 29.4%; it was about 18.0%. All other figures (gross profit, margins, operating income, net income, EPS, R&D) are correct.
